hotels.description: Embrace Hamptons-style elegance that's perfect for groups and families at this popular boutique retreat on the New South Wales Central Coast. Unplug from the everyday with a high-end escape in a natural paradise, where several sparkling beaches and bays meet the Bouddi National Park. Just a 90-minute drive north from Sydney’s CBD, Bells at Killcare Boutique Hotel, Restaurant & Spa is the perfect base to explore scenic bushwalking trails or stroll along Killcare Beach. The experience here is truly boutique - wake each day in your lodge fit for four, then start with a farm-to-table breakfast at The Wild Flower Bar & Dining, featuring fresh produce from the hotel’s own kitchen garden. Between the soothing treatments at Bells Day Spa, spending time at the hotel’s 20-metre lap pool or pool bar, unwinding with yoga and Pilates, or tasting wines with the in-house sommelier, you’ll slip effortlessly into a rhythm of relaxation. This sanctuary offers a true back-to-nature experience.
